text.tspan: : the maximum flow cannot exceed the capacity of any cut. Raising an edge off the cut leaves the original cut's capacity the same, so
Even an edge running at full capacity does not increase the maximum flow. a1→b1 gained as much as it was raised. Raise it further and
another cut will get in the way sooner or later. a2→b2 is on the cut, but another minimum cut without this edge remains, so nothing is
